"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The goal for both Medicare and Medicaid must be to assure that every participant receives the amount of care they need at the time they need it, whether for an expectant mother and her baby or for someone in the last moments of life.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Absent reforms, Medicare and Medicaid are headed for bankruptcy that will endanger care for seniors and the poor.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
